format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs

body: <sf-reference-link id="r-named" label="Ещё" href="#" aria-label="Все заказы клиента"></sf-reference-link>
Подробности в задаче и в .
<sf-reference-link id="r-tab" appearance="inline" label="Исходный код" href="https://github.com/simai/ui-source" target="_blank"></sf-reference-link>
<sf-reference-link id="r-gone" appearance="inline" icon="task_alt" label="№ 4790" href="#t4790" state="missing"></sf-reference-link>
<sf-reference-link id="r-copy" label="Начало работы" text="/ru/guide/" href="https://ui.simai.io/ru/guide/" copy></sf-reference-link>

probes.title: href draws a native link named by its label, the arrow before it
probes.covers: accessibility.role link, accessibility.name label, settings.icon default

steps.check: (() => { const a = document.querySelector('#r a.sf-reference-link__link'); return a && a.getAttribute('href') === '#start' && a.textContent.trim() === 'Начало работы' && document.querySelector('#r .sf-reference-link__icon').textContent.trim() === 'arrow_forward' && document.querySelector('#r .sf-reference-link__meta').textContent.trim() === '/guides/'; })()

probes.title: plain drops the card; an empty icon drops the arrow
disabled has no link; its label is a link that is unavailable
the host's aria-label names the link
an appearance off the list is the card
inline is a run in the sentence: the type icon, the name underlined, the number, no arrow by default
probes.covers: settings.appearance inline, settings.text, settings.icon default in text (C147 (1)-(3))

steps.check: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('#r-in .sf-reference-link'); const a = r && r.querySelector('a.sf-reference-link__link'); const p = document.querySelector('#para'); return r && r.classList.contains('sf-reference-link--inline') && getComputedStyle(r).display === 'inline' && a.querySelector('.sf-reference-link__icon').textContent === 'task_alt' && a.querySelector('.sf-reference-link__number').textContent === '№ 4812' && getComputedStyle(a.querySelector('.sf-reference-link__label')).textDecorationLine === 'underline' && !document.querySelector('#r-doc .sf-reference-link__icon') && Math.round(p.getBoundingClientRect().height) === Math.round(parseFloat(getComputedStyle(p).lineHeight)); })()

probes.title: target _blank adds the open_in_new sign and the words to the name

steps.check: (() => { const a = document.querySelector('#r-tab a'); return a.getAttribute('rel') === 'noopener noreferrer' && a.querySelector('.sf-reference-link__tab').textContent === 'open_in_new' && a.querySelector('.sf-reference-link__tab-words').textContent === '(откроется в новой вкладке)'; })()

probes.title: state missing or forbidden: no link, the broken-link icon, the reason in words

steps.check: (() => { const g = document.querySelector('#r-gone'); const c = document.querySelector('#r-closed'); return !g.querySelector('a') && g.querySelector('.sf-reference-link__icon').textContent === 'link_off' && g.querySelector('.sf-reference-link__reason').textContent === 'удалена' && !c.querySelector('a') && c.querySelector('.sf-reference-link__reason').textContent === 'нет доступа'; })()

probes.title: copy puts the clipboard route button at the card end with the full address

steps.check: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('#r-copy button.sf-reference-link__copy'); return b && b.getAttribute('data-sf-copy') === 'https://ui.simai.io/ru/guide/' && b.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Копировать ссылку' && !document.querySelector('#r .sf-reference-link__copy'); })()

probes.title: a name cut on its line has its whole text in the Framework tooltip

steps.check: (() => { const a = document.querySelector('#r-cut a'); const t = document.getElementById(a.getAttribute('data-tooltip')); return t && t.classList.contains('sf-tooltip') && t.textContent.trim() === 'Договор поставки оборудования для филиала в Екатеринбурге' && !document.querySelector('#r a[data-tooltip]'); })()
